messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Continuous optimization with log-barrier over all 286 triangle determinants

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration is unique up to symmetry and places 12 points on the boundary of the unit square (at least 3 on each side) with one interior point, emerging as the global minimizer of the log-barrier objective min_{p_i} -log(sum over all 286 triples of (det(p_j - p_i, p_k - p_i))^2), with all triangle areas equalized to a value of approximately 1/156 by the KKT conditions of the barrier problem."}
